name: fiber
description_en: ⚡️ Express inspired web framework written in Go
readme_excerpt: Fiber is an Express inspired web framework built on top of Fasthttp , the fastest HTTP engine for Go . Designed to ease things up for fast development with zero memory allocation and performance in mind. Tool Sponsors - supporting Fiber with free IDE licenses and AI credits     ⚙️ Installation Fiber requires Go version 1.25 or higher to run.
